verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante devadatte.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, on the Vulture’s Peak Mountain, not long after Devadatta had left.

verses.pali: Tatra bhagavā devadattaṁ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There the Buddha spoke to the mendicants about Devadatta:

verses.pali: “sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ attavipattiṁ paccavekkhitā hoti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, it’s good for a mendicant to check their own failings from time to time.

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ paravipattiṁ paccavekkhitā hoti.
verses.english: It’s good for a mendicant to check the failings of others from time to time.

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ attasampattiṁ paccavekkhitā hoti.
verses.english: It’s good for a mendicant to check their own successes from time to time.

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kālena kālaṁ parasampattiṁ paccavekkhitā hoti.
verses.english: It’s good for a mendicant to check the successes of others from time to time.

verses.pali: Aṭṭhahi, bhikkhave, asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
verses.english: Overcome and overwhelmed by eight things that oppose the true teaching, Devadatta is going to a place of loss, to hell, there to remain for an eon, irredeemable.

verses.pali: Lābhena hi, bhikkhave, abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
pāpamittatāya, bhikkhave, abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
verses.english: bad friendship, Devadatta is going to a place of loss, to hell, there to remain for an eon, irredeemable.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
verses.english: Overcome and overwhelmed by these eight things that oppose the true teaching, Devadatta is going to a place of loss, to hell, there to remain for an eon, irredeemable.

verses.pali: Sādhu, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṁ lābhaṁ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya,
verses.english: It’s good for a mendicant, whenever they encounter it, to overcome gain …

verses.pali: Kiñca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca uppannaṁ lābhaṁ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya,
verses.english: What advantage does a mendicant gain by overcoming these eight things?

verses.pali: Yaṁ hissa, bhikkhave, uppannaṁ lābhaṁ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṁ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṁ lābhaṁ abhibhuyya viharato evaṁsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
verses.english: The distressing and feverish defilements that might arise in someone who lives without overcoming these eight things do not arise when they have overcome them.

verses.pali: uppannaṁ pāpamittataṁ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṁ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṁ pāpamittataṁ abhibhuyya viharato evaṁsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
Idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthavasaṁ paṭicca uppannaṁ lābhaṁ abhibhuyya abhibhuyya vihareyya,
verses.english: This is the advantage that a mendicant gains by overcoming these eight things.
So, mendicants, you should train like this:
‘Whenever we encounter it, we will overcome gain …
